name: StoreFlow DrawerCart for WooCommerce
author: Mark Hendriksen

sections.description:
StoreFlow DrawerCart for WooCommerce adds a fast, customizable slide-in cart to your WooCommerce store, giving customers an easier way to review and update their cart without leaving the page.

The drawer provides a clean, self-contained cart experience with product controls, cart totals, coupons, free-shipping progress, payment badges, and floating cart triggers.

Customize the look and behavior directly from the WordPress admin and use the built-in Live Preview to see your changes while you work.

Key features include:

  • Customizable WooCommerce cart drawer
  • Live Preview while configuring the drawer
  • Ready-made starter presets
  • Quantity controls and product removal
  • Coupon form and coupon management
  • Free-shipping reward progress
  • Cart notices and messages
  • Checkout and continue-shopping actions
  • Payment badges
  • Floating cart trigger
  • Theme-agnostic design that works with standard WordPress themes
  • No coding required

StoreFlow DrawerCart for WooCommerce requires WooCommerce to be installed and active.

A separate Pro add-on is available for stores that need additional features such as recommended products, advanced rewards, premium presets, advanced customization, and express checkout integrations.

Learn more about StoreFlow DrawerCart and the optional Pro add-on at WP StoreFlow.

For setup and configuration guidance, see the StoreFlow DrawerCart documentation.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate WooCommerce.
  2. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/storeflow-drawercart-for-woocommerce/ directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress Plugins screen.
  3. Activate StoreFlow DrawerCart for WooCommerce through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  4. Go to the DrawerCart settings in the WordPress admin and configure the cart drawer for your store.
  5. Optional: install and activate the separate DrawerCart Pro add-on if you need its additional premium features.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require WooCommerce?

Yes. StoreFlow DrawerCart is built specifically for WooCommerce and requires WooCommerce to be installed and active.

Will it work with my WordPress theme?

StoreFlow DrawerCart is theme-agnostic and is designed to work with standard WordPress and WooCommerce themes.

Can I customize the drawer without writing code?

Yes. The plugin includes settings for the drawer layout, styling, cart elements, buttons, payment badges, messages, and other options. The built-in Live Preview lets you see many changes while configuring the drawer.

Does the plugin process payments?

No. StoreFlow DrawerCart provides the cart interface. Payments and checkout are still handled by WooCommerce and your configured payment gateway plugins.

Do I need the Pro add-on to use DrawerCart?

No. StoreFlow DrawerCart works as a standalone WooCommerce cart drawer. The Pro add-on is optional and adds additional advanced features.
